title: A Drop of Lime to Awaken

text_block_list.text: (—Shaka, shaka, shaka)

...—A rhythmic, crisp sound drifted into my hazy consciousness.
At the same time, a fresh citrus aroma brushed past my nose.
Wondering where the scent came from, I opened my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yo. Has your moratorium come to an end?

...Apparently, I had fallen asleep.
And for some reason, Tanino Gimlet was standing right before me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
God is dead. The time has come to bid farewell to myth.
In other words, I have begun to tread the present... but what of you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Surely you do not intend to indulge in perpetual respite forever?

Having just woken up, I had no idea what was going on...
Nor why she was even here in the first place—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Struck speechless by such a foolishly obvious question, are we?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You chose to raise your goblet to me.
Therefore, you bear the duty to be intoxicated by my essence.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Drink. It is the "Übermensch."
A mocktail had been poured into the glass before me.
Drawn in by the cool, glistening liquid, I took a sip.

Instantly—amidst the clean, refreshing flavor, a burst of crisp acidity
sparked through my senses, clearing the haze from my mind in a flash...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahhahahahaha!! Just like Venus manifesting upon this mortal coil!!
A radiant countenance!! A visage overflowing with the pure ecstasy of life!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!!! Awaken from winter's slumber
and sing praises unto spring!!! Savor this existence to the absolute fullest!!!!
choice_data_list: Thanks, that really woke me up.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, naturally. Just as you bear the duty to be intoxicated,
I bear the solemn duty to intoxicatingly enthrall.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And the intoxication of a gimlet is one that beckons the fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, it is only fitting that I bestow upon you a flash of that transient spark.
...Is that not so, my companion?
I felt like I sort of understood, yet didn't—
...No, actually, I don't get it at all.

Ever since the day we met, Tanino Gimlet's
words and actions had been eccentric and enigmatic.

And to be completely honest...
even after becoming her trainer, I still didn't quite understand her.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A dubious expression. Do my actions evoke that much doubt within thee?
choice_data_list: Well, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It matters not. Thou needst not strain thyself to spin idle words.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How the spirit undergoes three transformations, how
the lion becometh a child. I, too, have yet to unveil this to thee.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
In deference to thy will, I shall lay down guideposts for thee.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tread those stages, and in time,
thou shalt surely reach the core of my psyche.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For now, indulge in thy moratorium.
...I shall prepare a glass to awaken thee whenever thou art ready.

With those words, Tanino Gimlet departed.
What on earth could she have meant by "guideposts"...?

Either way, now that I was her trainer,
I felt I truly needed to understand her better.
